title: RTGA: A Redundancy-free Accelerator for High-Performance Temporal Graph Neural Network Inference
problem: Existing TGNN solutions suffer from redundant computation overhead and excessive off-chip communications due to redundant graph sampling and repeatedly fetching features and vertex memory. These inefficiencies significantly limit inference performance and energy efficiency.
motivation: Temporal Graph Neural Networks can capture the dynamic nature of complex networks, making them valuable for real-world applications, but current implementations waste significant computation and bandwidth through avoidable redundancy.
method: RTGA proposes a redundancy-aware execution approach that structures TGNN computation into a temporal tree to eliminate unnecessary data processing. It includes a temporal-aware data caching method to improve data locality and reduce off-chip communications. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Alveo U280 FPGA to accelerate TGNN inference.
key_novelty: Redundancy-aware execution using temporal tree structure to systematically eliminate unnecessary data processing in TGNN inference.
contributions: Redundancy-aware execution approach with temporal tree design for eliminating unnecessary TGNN computation
Temporal-aware data caching method to improve data locality and reduce off-chip communications
FPGA-based accelerator implementation achieving 473.2x-6.9x speedup over software and hardware baselines
Comprehensive energy efficiency analysis demonstrating 542.8x-8.3x energy savings
primary_theme: redundancy-free temporal graph neural network acceleration
